local nativeModding = Modding

local function disableCase()
if not UI.IsInFrontEnd() then error('main menu required') end
local enableIDs = {"7696e937-2044-4f3c-8e13-4e27632e2710"}
local disableIDs = {"403be889-1455-4de7-967b-ad54c0ff3431"}
local keep, disabled = {}, {}
for _, id in ipairs(enableIDs) do keep[string.lower(id)] = true end
local handles, dependents, original = {}, {}, {}
for _, installed in ipairs(Modding.GetInstalledMods()) do
    local info = Modding.GetModInfo(installed.Handle)
    local id = string.lower(info.Id)
    handles[id] = installed.Handle
    original[id] = info.Enabled
    local dependencies = Modding.GetModAssociations(installed.Handle)
    for _, dependency in ipairs(dependencies or {}) do
      local target = string.lower(dependency.Id)
      dependents[target] = dependents[target] or {}
      table.insert(dependents[target], id)
    end
end
local order = {}
if #disableIDs > 0 then
  local visiting, visited = {}, {}
  local function visit(id)
    if visiting[id] then error('mod dependency cycle: ' .. id) end
    if visited[id] then return end
    if keep[id] then error('scenario enables a dependent mod of a disable target: ' .. id) end
    visiting[id] = true
    local children = dependents[id] or {}
    table.sort(children)
    for _, child in ipairs(children) do visit(child) end
    local handle = handles[id]
    if handle and Modding.GetModInfo(handle).Enabled then table.insert(order, id) end
    visiting[id], visited[id] = nil, true
  end
  -- Build the complete order before changing anything, including paths through
  -- disabled intermediates. An enable-list conflict must not disable other mods.
  for _, id in ipairs(disableIDs) do visit(string.lower(id)) end
  local positions = {}
  for i, id in ipairs(order) do positions[id] = i end
  for i, id in ipairs(order) do
    local reason, _, sources = Modding.CanDisableMod(handles[id])
    if reason == 'MissingDependencies' and sources and #sources > 0 then
      -- The engine still sees dependents as enabled during preflight. Only
      -- dependencies already scheduled BEFORE this target can be resolved.
      for _, source in ipairs(sources) do
        local position = positions[string.lower(source.Id)]
        if not position or position >= i then
          error('cannot disable mod: ' .. id .. ' (unscheduled dependent ' .. source.Id .. ')')
        end
      end
    elseif reason ~= 'OK' then
      error('cannot disable mod: ' .. id .. ' (' .. tostring(reason) .. ')')
    end
  end
end
for _, id in ipairs(enableIDs) do
  if not Modding.GetModHandle(id) then error('mod is not installed: ' .. id) end
end
local ok, failure = pcall(function()
    for _, id in ipairs(order) do
      local handle = handles[id]
      local reason = Modding.CanDisableMod(handle)
      if reason ~= 'OK' then error('cannot disable mod: ' .. id .. ' (' .. tostring(reason) .. ')') end
      Modding.DisableMod(handle)
      if Modding.GetModInfo(handle).Enabled then error('mod stayed enabled: ' .. id) end
      table.insert(disabled, id)
    end
for _, id in ipairs(enableIDs) do
  local handle = Modding.GetModHandle(id)
  if not handle then error('mod is not installed: ' .. id) end
  if not Modding.GetModInfo(handle).Enabled then
    local reason = Modding.CanEnableMod(handle, true)
    if reason ~= 'OK' then error('cannot enable mod: ' .. id .. ' (' .. tostring(reason) .. ')') end
    Modding.EnableMod(handle, true)
  end
end
for _, id in ipairs(enableIDs) do
  if not Modding.GetModInfo(Modding.GetModHandle(id)).Enabled then error('mod did not become enabled: ' .. id) end
end
for _, id in ipairs(disableIDs) do
  local handle = Modding.GetModHandle(id)
  if handle and Modding.GetModInfo(handle).Enabled then error('mod stayed enabled: ' .. id) end
end
GameConfiguration.UpdateEnabledMods()
end)
if not ok then
  -- Restore the complete original selection, including prerequisites enabled
  -- implicitly by EnableMod(..., true), on failure in EITHER direction.
  local all, visited, restoreOrder = {}, {}, {}
  for id in pairs(handles) do table.insert(all, id) end
  table.sort(all)
  local function visit(id)
    if visited[id] then return end
    visited[id] = true
    local children = dependents[id] or {}
    table.sort(children)
    for _, child in ipairs(children) do visit(child) end
    if handles[id] then table.insert(restoreOrder, id) end
  end
  for _, id in ipairs(all) do visit(id) end
  local turnOff, changed = {}, false
  local function mark(id)
    if turnOff[id] then return end
    turnOff[id] = true
    for _, child in ipairs(dependents[id] or {}) do mark(child) end
  end
  for _, id in ipairs(all) do
    if Modding.GetModInfo(handles[id]).Enabled ~= original[id] then changed = true end
    if not original[id] and Modding.GetModInfo(handles[id]).Enabled then mark(id) end
  end
  local failures = {}
  for _, id in ipairs(restoreOrder) do
    if turnOff[id] and Modding.GetModInfo(handles[id]).Enabled then
      local restored, err = pcall(Modding.DisableMod, handles[id])
      if not restored or Modding.GetModInfo(handles[id]).Enabled then
        table.insert(failures, id .. ': ' .. tostring(err))
      end
    end
  end
  for i = #restoreOrder, 1, -1 do
    local id = restoreOrder[i]
    if original[id] and not Modding.GetModInfo(handles[id]).Enabled then
      -- False preserves an initially disabled intermediate prerequisite.
      local restored, err = pcall(Modding.EnableMod, handles[id], false)
      if not restored or not Modding.GetModInfo(handles[id]).Enabled then
        table.insert(failures, id .. ': ' .. tostring(err))
      end
    end
  end
  for _, id in ipairs(all) do
    if Modding.GetModInfo(handles[id]).Enabled ~= original[id] then
      table.insert(failures, id .. ': selection differs from original')
    end
  end
  if changed then
    local updated, err = pcall(GameConfiguration.UpdateEnabledMods)
    if not updated then table.insert(failures, 'configuration: ' .. tostring(err)) end
  end
  if #failures > 0 then error(tostring(failure) .. '; restoration failed: ' .. table.concat(failures, ', ')) end
  error(failure)
end
return table.concat(disabled, ', ')
end

if not UI.IsInFrontEnd() then error('main menu required') end
JAC_MOD_ROLLBACK_241 = nil
local nativeEnable, nativeDisable = Modding.EnableMod, Modding.DisableMod
if type(nativeEnable) ~= 'function' or type(nativeDisable) ~= 'function'
  or type(GameConfiguration.UpdateEnabledMods) ~= 'function' then
  error('required native MOD API missing before selection changes')
end
local function resetApis()
  local errors = {}
  local a, ae = pcall(function()
    Modding.EnableMod = nativeEnable
    if Modding.EnableMod ~= nativeEnable then error('enable API restore did not take effect') end
  end)
  local b, be = pcall(function()
    Modding.DisableMod = nativeDisable
    if Modding.DisableMod ~= nativeDisable then error('disable API restore did not take effect') end
  end)
  if not a then table.insert(errors, tostring(ae)) end
  if not b then table.insert(errors, tostring(be)) end
  return a and b, table.concat(errors, ';')
end
-- Probe both assignments before the first selection mutation.
local canWrap, wrapError = pcall(function()
  local enable = function(...) return nativeEnable(...) end
  local disable = function(...) return nativeDisable(...) end
  Modding.EnableMod, Modding.DisableMod = enable, disable
  if Modding.EnableMod ~= enable or Modding.DisableMod ~= disable then
    error('API assignment did not take effect')
  end
end)
local reset, resetError = resetApis()
if not canWrap or not reset then
  error('API assignment preflight failed: ' .. tostring(wrapError) .. ';' .. tostring(resetError))
end
local handles, ids, children, ordered = {}, {}, {}, {}
for _, mod in ipairs(Modding.GetInstalledMods()) do
  local id = string.lower(Modding.GetModInfo(mod.Handle).Id)
  handles[id] = mod.Handle
  table.insert(ids, id)
  for _, dep in ipairs(Modding.GetModAssociations(mod.Handle) or {}) do
    local target = string.lower(dep.Id)
    children[target] = children[target] or {}
    table.insert(children[target], id)
  end
end
table.sort(ids)
for _, id in ipairs({MAP, MIDDLE, LEAF, TREES, GROWTH}) do
  if not handles[id] then error('diagnostic MOD missing: ' .. id) end
end
local seen = {}
local function visit(id)
  if seen[id] then return end
  seen[id] = true
  local deps = children[id] or {}
  table.sort(deps)
  for _, child in ipairs(deps) do visit(child) end
  table.insert(ordered, id)
end
for _, id in ipairs(ids) do visit(id) end
local function enabled(id) return Modding.GetModInfo(handles[id]).Enabled end
local function snapshot()
  local state = {}
  for _, id in ipairs(ids) do state[id] = enabled(id) end
  return state
end
local function serialize(state)
  local values = {}
  for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
    table.insert(values, id .. '=' .. tostring(state[id]))
  end
  return table.concat(values, ',')
end
local function compare(expected, label)
  local mismatch = {}
  for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
    if enabled(id) ~= expected[id] then table.insert(mismatch, id) end
  end
  if #mismatch > 0 then error(label .. ': ' .. table.concat(mismatch, ',')) end
end
-- Cleanup is independent of the production transaction and always uses native APIs.
local function restore(expected)
  local failures = {}
  local off = {}
  local function markOff(id)
    if off[id] then return end
    off[id] = true
    for _, child in ipairs(children[id] or {}) do markOff(child) end
  end
  for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
    if not expected[id] and enabled(id) then markOff(id) end
  end
  for _, id in ipairs(ordered) do
    if off[id] and enabled(id) then
      local ok, err = pcall(nativeDisable, handles[id])
      if not ok then table.insert(failures, tostring(err)) end
    end
  end
  for i = #ordered, 1, -1 do
    local id = ordered[i]
    if expected[id] and not enabled(id) then
      local ok, err = pcall(nativeEnable, handles[id], false)
      if not ok then table.insert(failures, tostring(err)) end
    end
  end
  local ok, err = pcall(GameConfiguration.UpdateEnabledMods)
  if not ok then table.insert(failures, tostring(err)) end
  compare(expected, 'native cleanup selection mismatch')
  if #failures > 0 then error(table.concat(failures, ';')) end
end

  table.insert(passed, label)

  if enabled(id) ~= value then error('native preparation failed: ' .. id) end
end
local function expectFailure(fn, marker, expected)
  local ok, err = pcall(fn)
  local reset, resetError = resetApis()
  if not reset then error('API restore failed: ' .. resetError) end
  if ok or not string.find(tostring(err), marker, 1, true) then
    error('expected injected failure missing: ' .. tostring(err))
  end
  print('TODO241 EXPECTED ' .. tostring(err))
  compare(expected, 'production rollback selection mismatch')
end

  mark('disable-failure-restores-all-with-disabled-intermediate')

  for _, mixed in ipairs({false, true}) do
    force(GROWTH, true, true)
    force(LEAF, false)
    force(MIDDLE, false)

    Modding.EnableMod = function(handle, dependencies)

      if handle == handles[LEAF] and dependencies == true and not injected then

        for _, id in ipairs(ids) do

        end
        nativeSideEffect = enabled(MIDDLE) and count > 0

  force(LEAF, false)
  force(MIDDLE, false)
  force(LEAF, true, false)
  baseline = snapshot()
  injected = false
  Modding.DisableMod = function(handle)

  local reset, resetError = resetApis()
  local rejected = not accepted and injected
    and string.find(tostring(err), 'restoration failed:', 1, true)
    and string.find(tostring(err), 'selection differs from original', 1, true)
    and not enabled(LEAF)
  restore(baseline)
  if not reset then error('API restore failed: ' .. resetError) end
  if not rejected then error('incomplete rollback was not reported: ' .. tostring(err)) end

end)
local reset, resetError = resetApis()
local cleaned, cleanupError = pcall(restore, original)
print('TODO241 FINAL ' .. serialize(snapshot()))
if nativeModding.EnableMod ~= nativeEnable or nativeModding.DisableMod ~= nativeDisable then
  error('native MOD API changed during diagnostic')
end
print('TODO241 ENGINE_API_UNCHANGED')
if not cleaned then error(tostring(failure) .. '; cleanup failed: ' .. tostring(cleanupError)) end
if not reset then error(tostring(failure) .. '; API restore failed: ' .. resetError) end
if not ok then error(failure) end
if #passed ~= 5 then error('incomplete diagnostic coverage') end
JAC_MOD_ROLLBACK_241 = {passed=true, selection=serialize(snapshot())}
return 'TODO241 PASS 5/5 all-selection-restored installed=' .. #ids

if not JAC_MOD_ROLLBACK_241 or not JAC_MOD_ROLLBACK_241.passed then error('rollback diagnostic incomplete') end
